rationale: C06 is a highly plausible direct template: it concerns the same Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Company and uses the same three-recital sequence, thirty-day reporting requirement, and section 10 status-quo provision. The child principally substitutes a different employee representative and revises the geographic description of the threatened interruption. C20 and C01 are also close instances of the same standardized drafting form, but neither shares the child’s carrier, making C06 materially stronger.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Denver and Rio Grande Western Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Company a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Switchmen's Union of North America
shared_material.explanation: The opening recital uses the same carrier-specific formulation, with the union changed for the later dispute.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days form the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The operative reporting provision is substantively identical; “form” in C06 is evidently a textual error for “from.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Denver and Rio Grande Western Railroad Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same carrier-specific status-quo machinery is reproduced nearly verbatim, differing only in the rendering of the conjunction in the carrier’s name.
